title: Goji Berry Extract for Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Goji Berry for Hair: Antioxidant Research & Evidence | FullyVital
seo_description: What trials show about goji berries and antioxidant markers and skin carotenoids, the one mouse hair study, and what hasn't been tested in people.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (1,915 words, 0 study links) claimed hair growth and scalp benefits. Removed; rewritten around two human trials (antioxidant markers, skin carotenoids) and one mouse hair study.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
No human hair study exists. The mouse study tested a bergamot + boxthorn mix; the abstract used 'boxthorn' (Lycium), which I treated as goji. Say if you'd like that wording softened.
'Its key compounds include Lycium barbarum polysaccharides and zeaxanthin' comes from the trial abstracts' wording, not a dedicated source.
Evidence is thin for hair; you may prefer to hold or merge it.
